messages:
ellen (docs): Drafting region + residency doc for public site. Need quick accuracy check before PR.
mark (eng): We should separate 'available regions' (where endpoints run) from 'residency-enabled regions' (where customer data can be kept).
sue (legal): Wording: use 'may be stored' and reference the Data Residency add-on; don't promise residency unless enrolled.
elllen (docs): Typo: my bad — meant 'ellen' not 'elllen' in the draft. I'll use: "Customer data may be stored in the selected region when enrolled in the Data Residency add-on; see DPA for details."
kai (sdk): SDK examples: JS constructor uses `region` param; env var is `REDWOOD_REGION`. Show validation error snippet: `Error: unsupported region 'ap-east-1'`
mark (eng): Current state: endpoints: us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1, eu-north-1, ap-southeast-1. Residency add-on: us-west-2, eu-west-1 only. Hosted works everywhere; Dedicated available in us-west-2 and eu-west-1.
elllen (docs): I'll include a short migration note: switch from global to region endpoint: `https://api.{region}.redwood.ai/v1/generate` and SDK region examples.
build-bot: docs lint passed for docs/region-residency.md  preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/7890
sue (legal): Add link to SOC2 & DPA and note: encryption at rest/in transit; KMS available for Private.
elllen (docs): Thanks — opening PR and tagging reviewers.
